get_state.doc: The caller's own LAUNCH30 promo state — eligible_unseen | eligible_seen | claimed_active | claimed_expired | ineligible. Read-only, recomputed every call.

dismiss.doc: Record that Modal A was shown/dismissed on this surface, once, forever (server flag, not localStorage).

claim.doc: Claim the 1-month free Team trial: no card, no Stripe object. Bootstraps (or reuses) the caller's organisation, then grants a Team-plan yp.quota row for 30 days.

errors.description: not on Free, or already inside another organisation
